issuing_authority.value: Electrical Administrative Board / Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs
issuing_authority.quote: The electrical administrative board created in section 2 of former 1956 PA 217 shall continue in existence and is designated as the board for purposes of this article.

name.quote: The electrical administrative board created in section 2 of former 1956 PA 217 shall continue in existence and is designated as the board for purposes of this article.

type.quote: The board shall consist of 10 members, as follows: (a) The state fire marshal or his or her representative. (b) Nine members, who are residents of this state and appointed by the governor, including each of the following: (i) One member who is a representative of an insurance inspection bureau that operates in this state. (ii) One member who is a representative of an electrical energy supply agency that operates in this state. (iii) One member who is an electrical contractor that operates in this state. (iv) One member who is a master electrician who serves as a supervisor. (v) One member who is an electrical journeyman.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of licensing and regulatory affairs.

age_minimum.quote: The department shall issue an electrical journeyman's license to any individual who is at least 20 years old

moral_character_required.quote: "Good moral character" means that term as defined in, and determined under, 1974 PA 381, MCL 338.41 to 338.47.

required.quote: Has at least 8,000 hours of experience obtained over a period of at least 4 years related to electrical construction or maintenance of buildings or electrical wiring or equipment under the direct supervision of an individual who is licensed under this article.

duration.quote: Has at least 12,000 hours of experience that was obtained over a period of 6 years or more, is related to electrical construction, the maintenance of buildings, or electrical wiring or equipment, and was performed under the supervision of a master electrician.

exams.name: Electrical Journeyman Examination
exams.notes: Applicant ineligible after 2 failures within 2 years until 1-year waiting period and proof of approved course completion.
exams.quote: If an applicant fails to pass the electrical journeyman examination 2 times within a period of 2 years, the applicant is ineligible to sit for another examination until a period of at least 1 year after the date of failure of the second examination.

exams.name: Master Electrician Examination
exams.notes: Applicant ineligible after 2 failures within 2 years until 1-year waiting period and proof of approved course completion.
exams.quote: If he or she fails to pass the master electrician examination 2 times within a period of 2 years, an applicant is ineligible to sit for another examination for at least 1 year from the date of failure of the second examination.

exams.name: Electrical Contractor Examination
exams.quote: The examination fee for licensure of any of the following is $100.00: (a) Master electrician. (b) Electrical contractor. (c) Electrical journeyman.

interval_years.quote: Except as otherwise provided in subsection (5) or (7), a license expires on December 31 of each year and is renewable not more than 60 days after that date if an application is submitted and the appropriate fee is paid.

required.quote: As a condition of renewal of a master electrician's license, the master electrician must demonstrate the successful completion of a course, approved by the board, concerning any update or change in the state construction code within 12 months after the update or change in that code. This requirement applies only during or after those years that the state construction code is updated or changed.

value: state construction code updates or changes
topical_requirements.quote: must demonstrate the successful completion of a course, approved by the board, concerning any update or change in the state construction code within 12 months after the update or change in that code.

available.quote: the board and department shall issue a license without examination to an individual seeking sign specialty licensure if he or she is licensed, registered, or otherwise regulated in another state and the board determines that the standards in the other state meet or exceed the standards imposed in this article.

requirements.value: For sign specialty licensure, board and department may issue without examination if licensed in another state with equivalent or higher standards. For military members/veterans/dependents, license without examination available if requirements of other state are substantially equivalent. Temporary license available for out-of-state licensees in good standing.
requirements.quote: Notwithstanding any other provisions of this article and after a proper application is submitted and the appropriate fees paid, the board and department shall issue a license without examination to an individual seeking sign specialty licensure if he or she is licensed, registered, or otherwise regulated in another state and the board determines that the standards in the other state meet or exceed the standards imposed in this article.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical wiring" means all wiring, generating equipment, fixtures, appliances, devices, and appurtenances in connection with the generation, distribution, and utilization of electrical energy, in or on a building, residence, structure, or properties, regardless of whether or not the electrical wiring is energized at the time of installation.
